name: Editorial line masks
technique: Magazine layout in the app's own voice: mono kicker with an accent dash, a serif headline whose lines (split where the writer puts '|') rise out of masks, an accent rule grows, and the body copy turns from faint to ink word by word at reading pace.

title.label: Headline (| = line break, *accent*)
title.default: Tregu i pronave,|*më i qartë*|se kurrë.

body.label: Body
body.default: Çmime, foto, harta dhe detaje — në shqip, anglisht, italisht dhe në 5 gjuhë të tjera.
